description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function named 'sugar_getimage' used to generate HTML image elements or sprites for SuiteCRM. It includes licensing information and the implementation of the function that retrieves images via the SugarThemeRegistry.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getimage
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML image or sprite using parameters, interacting with the SugarThemeRegistry to retrieve the image.
